messages:
janet: CI image publish failing on master after Dockerfile tweak (chown of /app). job: image-build-push #4591
ci-bot: Job image-build-push #4591 failed: exit code 1 - pushed 0/5 layers
matt: ugh, saw that locally too, seems to hang at "Pushing layer" then timeout
sophia: can someone paste the push error lines? also did creds rotate recently?
janet: log snippet:
```
Pushing layer sha256:abcd...: 32% complete
error uploading layer: Put "https://registry.redwood.example/v2/.../blobs/uploads/": EOF
```
matt: EOF during chunked upload usually points to connection/reset from registry or bad layer size from tar
oliver: cc @sophia — I didn't touch registry tokens. i can run a manual push from CI builder vm
rachael: can we try rerunning job with `--no-cache`? Dockerfile change added `RUN chown -R app:app /app` which created a huge tar stream change
sophia: good call — chown will change many inode metadata and may invalidate layer caching and increase layer size. also we had a recent nginx proxy upgrade that started returning 502 on long uploads
janet: matt can you kick a rerun with `BUILDX_NO_CACHE=1` and set `--max-concurrent-uploads=4`? (we had a bug with concurrent uploads earlier)
matt: kicked: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4591/rerun
ci-bot: Rerun queued for image-build-push #4591 (agent: builder-7)
oliver: if rerun fails, try `docker buildx build --push --progress=plain --no-cache --compress` from a clean builder host — compression helped before
matt: rerun completed: failed again but different error fragment:
```
http2: server sent GOAWAY and closed the connection
```
sophia: OK that points to proxy/nginx limits. i'll check infra side (nginx timeouts, proxy buffering) and also request registry logs for that timeframe
rachael: also consider move chown into a chown-less approach: set correct uid at copy, or do chown in a separate lighter layer and then squash—reduces size
janet: thanks team. action items: infra (sophia) investigate proxy & registry logs; eng-infra (matt/oliver) attempt manual push from builder host with compression and adjusted concurrent uploads; dev (rachael) propose Dockerfile tweak PR if needed. ping here with updates.
